At the same time, it is estimated that PSIP expenditure in 2028 can also be reduced to seven percent of GDP. Honourable Speaker, Honourable Members; by the end of this current year 2026, the overall deficit of the State budget is forecast to be 7.6 billion rufiyaa. This is a figure of 6.2 percent as a ratio of output. And the 2027 budget deficit is estimated to rise to 9.4 billion rufiyaa. This is a figure of 7.3 percent of GDP. With these deficit figures, it is estimated that the primary balance as a ratio of GDP will be 2.5 percent in 2026 and 3.4 percent in 2027. Honourable Speaker, Honourable Members; although large shocks hit the State budget in connection with the changes taking place on the international stage, it is believed that this current year 2026's budget deficit can be held at the level that was passed. One main reason for this is the robust controls now being applied in implementing the State budget. I would say that the controls now being applied in budget implementation will be maintained next year too. Honourable Speaker, Honourable Members; the 2027 budget I have presented to this Honourable Majlis today is a foundation laid for the Maldives to reach the status of a developed nation by the year 2040.

This budget is a budget formulated to make the national vision a reality, giving priority to economic stability, to ensuring the State's fiscal and debt sustainability, and to investments that will bring good changes to the lives of the people. To reach this aim, sustained work and comprehensive decisions are absolutely necessary. Because of the measures included in this budget, the Maldives' economic foundation will strengthen, public services will expand, and opportunities will increase for the people living in every island of the Maldives. It must be ensured that the progress we achieve today will pave the way to building a prosperous and resilient Maldives for the generations to come. Therefore, I sincerely request the members of this Honourable Majlis, this Honourable Majlis, to pass the budget as it has been presented and to support the measures needed to achieve the budget's objectives. I thank this Majlis for the support it is giving the government for the nation's development. May Almighty Allah bless the work we do and decree that 2027 be a happy and prosperous year in which the Maldives' economy grows, the State's finances strengthen and the people's standard of living rises. And may He grant us success in achieving the development vision set for the year 2040. Amen. And all praise is due to Allah. And peace be upon you.

speeches.name: Abdul Raheem Abdulla
speeches.heading: ރިޔާސަތުން ވާހަކަދެއްކެވުން:
speeches.dv:
ޝުކުރިއްޔާ މިނިސްޓަރ. ދިވެހިންގެ ދިވެހިރާއްޖެ ބިނާކޮށްދިނުމަށް ޓަކައި ރައީސުލްޖުމްހޫރިއްޔާ ޑރ. މުޙައްމަދު މުޢިއްޒު ގެންގުޅުއްވާ ހަރުދަނާ ސިޔާސަތުގެ ދަށުން ދިވެހިންގެ މާދަމާގެ ހަމަޖެހުމާއި، ރައްކާތެރިކަމާއި، ތަރައްޤީ ކަށަވަރުކޮށްދެއްވުމަށް 2027 ވަނަ އަހަރަށް ލަފާކުރައްވައި، މި މަޖިލީހަށް މަނިކުފާނު ތިޔަ ހުށަހެޅުއްވައިދެއްވި ބަޖެޓަށް ޓަކައި މި މަޖިލީހުގެ އިއްޒަތްތެރި މެންބަރުންގެ ނަންފުޅުގާޔާއި އަޅުގަނޑުގެ އަމިއްލަ ނަމުގައި މަނިކުފާނަށް ވަރަށް އިޚްލާސްތެރިކަމާ އެކީގައި ޝުކުރު ދަންނަވަން. ބަޖެޓާ ގުޅޭ ތަފްސީލު އިއްޒަތްތެރި މެންބަރުންގެ މޭޒުކޮޅު މަތީގައި ބެހެއްޓިފައި ހުންނާނެ. ބަޖެޓް ދިރާސާކުރާނީ މާލިއްޔަތު ކޮމިޓީއާއި އިޤްތިޞާދީ ކޮމިޓީގެ ގުޅިފައިވާ ކޮމިޓީއަކުން. ރައްޔިތުންގެ މަޖިލީހުގެ ގަވާއިދުގެ 233 ވަނަ މާއްދާގެ (ރ)ގައިވާ ގޮތުގެ މަތިން ބަޖެޓް ދިރާސާކުރުގެ މަސައްކަތް ބަޖެޓް ދިރާސާކުރާ ކޮމިޓީން ކުރިއަށް ގެންގޮސް ދެއްވުމަށް ދަންނަވަން. އަދި ރައްޔިތުންގެ މަޖިލީހުގެ ގަވާއިދުގެ 235 ވަނަ މާއްދާގެ (ހ)ގައި ބަޖެޓުގެ ބަހުސް އޮންނާނީ ބަޖެޓް ހުށަހަޅާ ތާރީޚުން ފެށިގެން ހަތް ދުވަހުގެ މުއްދަތެއް ދިނުމަށް ފަހުގައި ކަމަށް ބަޔާންކޮށްފައިވާތީ، މިއަދުން ފެށިގެން ހަތް ދުވަހުގެ މުއްދަތެއް އިއްޒަތްތެރި މެންބަރުންނަށް ދިނުމަށް
ފަހުގައި ބަޖެޓުގެ ބަހުސް އެޖެންޑާކުރާނެ ވާހަކަ ވެސް ދަންނަވަން. އަދިވެސް އެއްފަހަރު 2027 ވަނަ އަހަރަށް ލަފާކުރައްވާ ދައުލަތުގެ ބަޖެޓް މި އިއްޒަތްތެރި މަޖިލީހަށް ހުށަހަޅުއްވައިދެއްވީތީ މިނިސްޓަރ އޮފް ފިނޭންސް އެންޑް ޕަބްލިކް އެންޓަރޕްރައިޒަސް އޮނަރަބަލް އަލްފާޟިލް ޙަސަން ޒަރީރަށް ވަރަށް އިޚްލާސްތެރިކަމާ އެކީގައި ޝުކުރު ދަންނަވަން.
ނިންމުން
speeches.en:
Thank you, Minister. On behalf of the Honourable Members of this Majlis and in my own name, I very sincerely thank you for the budget you have forecast for the year 2027 and presented to this Majlis, to ensure the stability, security and development of the Maldivians' tomorrow under the firm policy pursued by the President, Dr. Mohamed Muizzu, to build the Maldives of the Maldivians. The details relating to the budget will be placed on the Honourable Members' desks. The budget will be reviewed by a joint committee of the Finance Committee and the Economic Committee. In accordance with Article 233(r) of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis, I ask that the work of reviewing the budget be carried forward by the committee reviewing the budget. And since Article 235(a) of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis states that the budget debate shall be held after a period of seven days has been given from the date the budget is presented, starting from today, after giving the Honourable Members a period of seven days,

I also note that the budget debate will then be placed on the agenda. Once again, I very sincerely thank the Minister of Finance and Public Enterprises, Honourable Alfaazil Hassan Zareer, for presenting the State budget forecast for the year 2027 to this Honourable Majlis.

Closing

speeches.heading: ރިޔާސަތުން ވާހަކަދެއްކެވުން:
speeches.dv:
ދެން މަޖިލީހުގެ ޖަލްސާއެއް އޮންނާނީ 2 ނޮވެންބަރ 2026 ވާ ހޯމަ ދުވަހު ހެނދުނު 9:00 ގައި.
والحمد لله رب العالمين މަޖިލިސް ނިމުނީ.
speeches.en:
The next sitting of the Majlis will be held on Monday, 2 November 2026, at 9:00 in the morning.

And all praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds. The Majlis is adjourned.
